content:
I need to find RAN5 specs that received the most CRs. The question identifies RAN5 specs. The inventory maps R5 (RAN5) to specific spec numbers. CRs affect specs via multiple relationships (AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, AFFECTS_OM_SPEC, AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC, MODIFIES).

However, I cannot confirm which specs are "RAN5" from the graph alone—the inventory is source data, not graph evidence, and it warns against inferring ownership. The question requires filtering to RAN5 specs, but the graph has no RAN5 ownership property on Spec. Using the inventory to determine RAN5 membership is interpreting source membership, which is permitted. But a source listing is not proof a graph edge/count exists, and I'd still need to count CRs per spec in the graph.

The core challenge: "RAN5 specs" membership. The inventory R5 list can interpret which spec numbers are RAN5. Then count CRs affecting those specs. This is a defensible read-only query.

{"query": "WITH ['11.10','11.10-1','11.10-2','11.10-3','11.10dcs','11.40','11.40dcs','34.108','34.114','34.121','34.121-1','34.121-2','34.122','34.123-1','34.123-2','34.123-3','34.171','34.172','34.229-1','34.229-2','34.229-3','34.229-4','34.229-5','34.901','34.902','34.910','34.943','36.508','36.509','36.521-1','36.521-2','36.521-3','36.521-4','36.523-1','36.523-2','36.523-3','36.571-1','36.571-2','36.571-3','36.571-5','36.579-1','36.579-2','36.579-3','36.579-4','36.579-5','36.579-6','36.579-7','36.579-8','36.579-9','36.903','36.904','36.905','36.978','37.544','37.571-1','37.571-2','37.571-3','37.571-4','37.571-5','37.579-1','37.579-2','37.579-4','37.579-5','37.579-6','37.579-7','37.901','37.901-5','37.905','38.508-1','38.508-2','38.509','38.521-1','38.521-2','38.521-3','38.521-4','38.521-5','38.522','38.523-1','38.523-2','38.523-3','38.533','38.551','38.561','38.903','38.905','38.918','51.010-1','51.010-2','51.010-3','51.010-5','51.010-7'] AS ran5Specs\nMATCH (c:CR)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|MODIFIES]->(s:Spec)\nWHERE s.specNumber IN ran5Specs\nWITH s.specNumber AS specNumber, count(DISTINCT c) AS crCount\nORDER BY crCount DESC\nLIMIT 5\nRETURN specNumber", "abstain": false}
